projects.title: NodePay
projects.description: Real-time payment platform with microservices, AI-powered queries, and centralized authentication.
projects.challenge: Manage financial transactions in real-time with high concurrency and avoid inconsistencies.
projects.solution: Microservices architecture with WebSockets, DDD, and strict control of business rules, ensuring consistency and low latency.

engineering.architectureExplanation: A decoupled microservices architecture was designed, separating the user domain, AI, and frontend. Hybrid communication (REST + WebSockets) was implemented to optimize synchronous operations and real-time events. Keycloak was integrated for centralized authentication, along with an AI service using RAG + SQL Agent for intelligent queries over data and documents.
technicalKeyPoints: RAG + SQL Agent for contextual AI

projects.title: Subtitler
projects.description: AI-driven subtitle generator that processes video asynchronously with real-time progress feedback.
projects.challenge: Process heavy videos without blocking the system while maintaining real-time feedback for the user.
projects.solution: Asynchronous pipeline with Celery + Redis, distributed processing, and event streaming with SSE.

engineering.architectureExplanation: Clean Architecture with DDD was implemented, separating domain, application, and infrastructure. Video processing is completely decoupled via workers (Celery), while Redis acts as a broker and real-time event channel (SSE). Direct uploads to Azure eliminate backend bottlenecks.
